checks.scope: Only BRIEF-13 Part B: badlands-prop-0..7 and badlands@winter-prop-0..7 receive verdicts. Other art is comparison material only. All out/ PNG SHA-256 hashes match the snapshot taken before compositing; no out/ file was edited.
checks.scales: Every Part B sprite visually inspected at native 1x and nearest-neighbour 4x over approved plains, grass and wasteland dirt/snow, and at nearest-neighbour 8x over a checkerboard. All 76 saved QC PNGs were visually inspected. Enlargements use no filtering.
checks.base_3x3: Not applicable: Part B contains no base files. Approved bases are comparison substrates, not additional review subjects.
checks.peak_lattice_or_range: Not applicable: Part B contains no peak/ridge files. Additional summer and winter mixed-size mesa landscapes inspected at 1x/4x, with all eight designs and repeated large mesas. They read as raised, stratified landforms, without an egg-crate or hollow crater field.
checks.trees_in_forest: Not applicable: Part B contains no trees. Flat orange autumn and identical crowns do not apply to these files.
checks.small_random_8x2: Both seasons inspected at 1x/4x in seeded random 8x2 arrangements over plains and wasteland bases (seed 1302; each of 0..3 appears four times). No seams, ground squares, edge frames or tile-border grid. Exact asset repetitions are visible, especially the deliberately repeated adjacent prop 2, but the four source designs are distinct; this is not a set of near-duplicates or a baked repeating surface.
checks.size_placement: All 16 files present and RGBA. Indices 0..3 are 48x48, 4..7 are 96x96. Visible small widths 36..38 px (75..79%); large widths 81..82 px (84..85%). Transparent margins and centred footprints are retained; no edge clipping. Low oblique landforms need not occupy the same vertical extent as their footprint width.
checks.pixel_quality: Crisp native pixel clusters; no blur, accidental antialiasing, noisy stippling, muddy silhouettes or pale/dark matte fringe found at 8x or on light/dark ground. Translucency is deliberate: black contact shading and the see-through crack overlay. No opaque ground square.
checks.palette_light: Tan caps and layered red-brown faces fit the approved warm earth, timber and roof colours. Top/upper-left surfaces receive light; right flanks remain darker. Checked against all 24 markers, round-2 city/industry/slums, suburb/farmland, paddies, grass/plains bases and details, and approved hills/dunes/craters. No palette clash or reversed light found.
checks.contact_shadows: Previous failures repaired. Summer prop 6 now has 80 black alpha-64 pixels (previously 4); winter prop 6 has 83 (previously 5). The audit masks show a narrow irregular strip under the lower/right foot, comparable to large passed props 4/5/7 (57..71 such pixels). Visually checked at 1x/4x on pale neutral ground and terrain, and at 8x on checkerboard. No detached shadow, enclosing halo, ground slab or over-heavy outline. Other raised props retain contact shadows; the flat crack overlay does not need a raised-object cast shadow.
checks.winter: All eight winter files retain their summer subject and placement, with pale snow/frost on caps and ledges and exposed strata beneath. Winter prop 3 has deliberate translucent frost along selected crack lips, remains readable at 1x/4x and does not become an opaque ground patch. No blank or seasonally inconsistent variant.
checks.specific_failure_modes: No blob/speck/square, egg-crate field, Swiss-cheese hollow, classical column/ruin/arena or stamped cyberpunk grid found. Large 6 has a continuous raised cap, asymmetric shoulder and stratified front. Its cap/outline differs from the notched mesa 4, stepped mesa 5 and low elongated mesa 7. Tree/autumn failure modes do not apply.
checks.calibration: Good enough to ship beside the approved art. All 14 passes from critic-r13B-2 are SHA-256 identical and remain passed; reinspection found no concrete new defect. The only changed files are the two prior failures, and their required shadow repair survives the visual checks.

badlands-prop-0.assessment: Squat butte with irregular lit cap, readable layered face and grounded foot. Distinct from the paired stepped mass in 2. Unchanged prior pass; no concrete new defect.

badlands-prop-1.assessment: Unequal slender rock spires with shared rocky foot, clean tapered silhouettes and consistent upper-left highlights. Unchanged prior pass; no concrete new defect.

badlands-prop-2.assessment: Two unequal flat-topped buttes joined as a stepped mass; cap/face separation and darker right side read at native size. Unchanged prior pass; no concrete new defect.

badlands-prop-3.assessment: Sparse tapering translucent fissures read as cracked ground without a tinted slab, hard rectangular perimeter or repeated grid. Unchanged prior pass; no concrete new defect.

badlands-prop-4.assessment: Broad asymmetric mesa with a notched cap, red-brown strata and irregular rocky foot; reads as a landform at native size. Unchanged prior pass; no concrete new defect.

badlands-prop-5.assessment: Connected descending terraces, clearly different in silhouette from 4, 6 and 7; ledges and contact remain legible at 1x. Unchanged prior pass; no concrete new defect.

badlands-prop-6.assessment: Repaired: a raised mesa with continuous cap and stratified front now meets the ground through a restrained broken translucent contact strip. No former hollow/arena reading, no fringe, and no new opaque rock changes apparent in the visual comparison. Previous missing-contact-shadow failure resolved.

badlands-prop-7.assessment: Low elongated mesa with raised shoulder and separate foot rock; useful silhouette variation at the required large footprint. Unchanged prior pass; no concrete new defect.
